proposals.current_text: Forty-eight students completed the course (60.0%), while the remaining 32 did not complete it.

proposals.original_text: Among all 80 recruited students, 48 had documented course completion (60.0%), 28 had documented noncompletion (35.0%), and four had no recorded follow-up outcome (5.0%). Actual completion across the full cohort was therefore between 60.0% and 65.0%.
